post_clip.description: At ~6.5s, the person on the right (wearing dark jacket) suddenly raises both hands above head in a surrender-like posture while turning toward the back of the store; simultaneously, a second individual (in red shirt) enters rapidly from the rear background (~9s–10.5s) moving purposefully toward the counter area. The first person’s abrupt hand-raising without physical contact, combined with the sudden entry and movement of the second person, is highly consistent with an armed robbery or threat scenario—especially given the context of expected shooting anomalies (e.g., people reacting to gunfire or weapon display without visible gun). No one falls or scatters yet, but the behavior is highly suspicious and deviates sharply from normal retail interaction.
